decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). Both backends are also off: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185). | WHY: The answer says the shipped config leaves MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and its backends undefined, so no mutex is compiled in by default. That covers a default build defining neither of the two threading macros the item refers to (taken here as THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT). || QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). - Both backends are also off: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185)." | WHY: The answer says the shipped config leaves THREADING_C and the PTHREAD/ALT backend macros undefined by default, so no mutexes are compiled in.
